# What android's NavHost cannot carry is refused where it is written, rather
# than emitted as Kotlin that does not compile.
#
# A page's params are its route, a @Serializable class, so every type they
# reach has to serialize: a string, a number, a bool, an enum, a struct of
# those, a list, a map or an option of them. A datetime is a host value with
# no serializer.
#
# And the NavHost is Compose, which is Kotlin: under --lang go the program's
# functions are emitted into a gomobile module, where a `go` has no
# NavController to call.

! sngl generate --platform android --lang kotlin -o out when.sngl
stderr 'when.sngl:14:23: android carries a page.s params in its route, and Slot.at is a datetime, which has no serializer: give the page params of strings, numbers, bools, enums and structs, lists, maps and options of them'

! sngl generate --platform android --lang go -o out golib.sngl
stderr 'golib.sngl:5:8: android renders sngl:ui/nav through a Compose NavHost, which is Kotlin: build this program with --lang kotlin'

-- when.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import time "sngl:time"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Slot {
    at time.datetime
}

ui.window {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #home(href="/") {
            ui.text(value="home")
        }
        nav.page #slot(href="/slot", params=Slot{}) {
            ui.text(value="slot")
        }
    }
}
-- golib.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #home(href="/") {
            ui.text(value="home")
        }
    }
}
